fee_notes: Royalty Fee is 6.0% of preceding month's Gross Room Revenues ("GRR"). Marketing and Reservation Fee is 3.5% of preceding month's GRR covering reservations system, advertising, marketing, and franchise services. Rewards Program Fee is 4.5%-5.5% of room revenue generated by rewards program members (variable based on Performance Based Loyalty Fee program). Airline Frequent Traveler Program Fee is 5% of room revenue from airline frequent travelers. Choice Accelerate is 3% of gross room revenue from direct online channel bookings (consumed stays); international marketing/meta stays subject to up to 10%. Programs Processing Fee is $0.12 per transaction per eligible stay. Third Party Distribution Fee is $4.00 per consumed reservation through directly connected OTAs. Travel Agent commissions are 10%-15% (standard) plus $0.48 per commissionable transaction via Onyx. Egencia/Hopper Preferred Programs: $5.00 per night loyalty fee. Leisure Affinity Promotional Program: $2.50 per preferred room night (or up to 10% commission). GDS fee: currently $7.70 per reservation. Platform Marketing Distribution: up to 15% commission. Global Sales Pay for Performance: 2.7% of total room revenue. FedRooms/DoD Program: 2.25% of room revenue. Property Technology & Service Fee: $10.10 per room/month ($650 min, $950 max). CrowdStrike: $60/month. ChoiceROCS (mandatory for Comfort): $970-$1,900/month. ChoiceMAX (mandatory for Comfort): $400-$525/month (bundled with ChoiceROCS). ChoiceMAX Training/Setup Fee: $2,500 one-time. CHOC Dues: $60/month. Regional Franchise Meeting Fee: $299/attendee annually. Annual Convention: $1,700/attendee annually. Educational Resources Program: $1,500/year. Additional Training: $49-$499. Re-Licensed Hotel Training: $995. Room Count Change Fee: not less than $1,000. Assumption Fee: $7,500. Property Improvement Plan Fee: $3,000. Comfort Letter Fee: $2,500 (plus $500 expedite). Choice Privileges Elite Welcome Recognition: ~$0.005 per point. Transfer Fee: greater of current affiliation fee or $65,000. Close Family Member Transfer Fee: $0-$7,500. Change of Ownership: $3,000. Points Accelerator: ~$0.005 per point. Insurance Reimbursement: $500-$100,000. ResConnect (optional): 3.50% of monthly GRR booked by ResConnect team. Marketing Cooperative Fee (optional/voluntary): $400-$2,400 annually. Tech fee not disclosed as a single flat monthly figure; Property Technology & Service Fee is per-room-based ($10.10/room/month, $650 min, $950 max).
raw_excerpt:
TYPE OF FEE AMOUNT (Note 1) DUE DATE REMARKS
GENERAL
Royalty Fee 6.0% of the preceding month's Gross Room Revenues ("GRR") (Note 2). Payable monthly.
Marketing and Reservation Fee 3.5% of the preceding month's GRR (Note 2). Payable monthly. The Marketing and Reservation Fee covers the ongoing development, maintenance and upgrading of the reservations system, as well as pay for expenditures associated with media, advertising, publicity, public relations, marketing, reservations and certain franchise services.
Rewards Program Fee (Choice Privileges Loyalty Program) 4.5% - 5.5% of room revenue generated by rewards program members. Monthly.
Airline Frequent Traveler Program Fee 5% of room revenue generated by airline frequent travelers. Payable monthly.
Choice Accelerate 3% of gross room revenue from consumed stays delivered from direct online channel bookings (certain exclusions and stay caps apply). International marketing paid and meta advertising efforts subject to a fee of up to 10% of gross room revenue. Payable monthly.
Programs Processing Fee $0.12 per transaction per eligible stay for Reward Program or Choice Accelerate fees. Payable monthly.
Third Party Distribution Fee $4.00 for each consumed reservation made through directly connected online travel agents, DerbySoft, DHISCO, myRiva, Juniper/Roibos and Katanox. Payable monthly.
Travel Agent and Other Reservation Based Commissions (Note 4) Standard commission (currently 10% - 15%). Weekly or monthly.
Egencia and Hopper Preferred Programs $5.00 per night Choice Privileges fee covering 1,000 loyalty points. As incurred.
Leisure Affinity Promotional Program $2.50 (or up to the equivalent of a 10% commission) per preferred room night. Payable monthly.
Global Distribution System ("GDS") Currently $7.70 for each reservation received through a GDS. Payable monthly.
Platform Marketing Distribution Up to 15% commission for consumed reservations generated through Choice's third-party marketing platform. Payable monthly and as incurred.
Global Sales Pay for Performance Program (Note 5) 2.7% of total room revenue from consumed business. Payable monthly.
FedRooms/DoD Program 2.25% of room revenue per consumed stays resulting from program activities. As incurred.
Property Technology & Service Fee $10.10 per room monthly, subject to a $650 minimum and $950 maximum. Payable monthly.
choiceADVANTAGE® Database Clean Up Fee $500. As incurred.
CrowdStrike $60. Payable monthly.
Choice Revenue Optimization Services ("ChoiceROCS") (See Note 6) $970 - $1,900 based on offering tier/service levels and brand. Monthly. Participation in ChoiceROCS is mandatory for COMFORT hotels.
ChoiceMAX (or similar program)(See Note 6) $400 - $525 based on number of rooms. Monthly. Mandatory for COMFORT hotels.
ChoiceMAX Training and Set Up Fee and/or reinstatement fee $2,500. At the time of ChoiceMAX installation.
Choice Hotels Owners Council (CHOC) Dues $60/month. Payable monthly.
Association's Regional Franchise Meeting Fee $299 per attendee plus travel, lodging and living expenses. Annually.
Annual Convention Registration Fee $1,700 per attendee plus travel, lodging, and living expenses. Annually.
Educational Resources Program $1,500 plus any applicable taxes. Annually (billed quarterly).
Additional Training Programs $49 - $499. On enrollment.
Re-Licensed Hotel Training $995. Within 90 days of transfer and franchise agreement execution.
Room Count Change Fee The per-room charge then being charged for new franchisees, but not less than $1,000. Before expansion of sleeping rooms.
Assumption Fee $7,500. Upon submission of application.
Property Improvement Plan Fee $3,000. Upon transferee's submission of application.
Comfort Letter Fee $2,500 (if needed within 1-3 days, additional $500 expedite fee). Upon request.
Choice Privileges Elite Welcome Recognition Program Approximately $0.005 per Choice Privileges point awarded to guest, or the cost of the gift provided to guest. Monthly/As incurred.
Transfer Fee The then current affiliation fee or $65,000, whichever is greater. Upon transferee's submission of application.
Close Family Member Transfer Fee $0-$7,500. Upon transferee's submission of application.
Change of Ownership $3,000. Upon submission of application.
Choice Privileges "Points Accelerator" Packages Approximately $0.005 per Choice Privileges point awarded to a guest. Monthly.
Insurance Reimbursement Fee $500-$100,000. As incurred.
Taxes Amount assessed by federal, state and local tax authorities. When invoiced.
OPTIONAL
Sales Certification Training Program $500 per attendee. On enrollment.
ResConnect Program 3.50% of monthly Gross Room Revenue booked by ResConnect team. Payable monthly.
Choice Privileges Meeting/Group Planner Point Program $0.005 per Choice Privileges point awarded. Payable monthly.
Marketing Cooperative Fee $400 - $2,400 annually. Payable by December 31st of each year.
RevUp Powered by Koddi Varies dependent on investment level. Payable monthly.
